notes.title: 23.10.23 - The long wait is over! Our demo is out!
notes.notes:
Hello, loyal fans!

This time – no tricks! The demo of our game has just been launched on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/540d4ef1165dc4d461c14e6025b82797779215c0.png[/img]

We won’t lie, it took us much longer than we’ve planned. In the end, however, we’ve done it! You can download the „ClockVenture” demo at this very moment and see how it looks.

Additionally, we present to you our Discord server ([url=https://discord.gg/MZE3mXUytj]Here :][/url]). Make yourself at home!

Thank you for the wait! Download the game and see for yourself that it’s been worth it! Ciao!

notes.title: 06.02.23 - What's the situation with this demo?
notes.notes:
Hello, our patient friends!

You're probably asking yourselves the question from the title of this announcement. We're glad to give you an answer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/540d4ef1165dc4d461c14e6025b82797779215c0.png[/img]

The first plan was to allow you to play the demo of "ClockVenture" at the beginning of this month, just before the February edition of the Steam Next Fest. Sadly, just at the end of development it turned out, that our game has a few serious bugs.

Our goal is to show you the results of our work with the best quality possible. That's why we're forced to postpone the release of the demo one more time. It's hard to give you the exact date, but we can assure you, that it's almost the end of this journey.

Thank you for your patience! We'll see you soon!

notes.title: 10.01.23 - A small change of the demo date
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowboys!

Do you remember how we talked about releasing the demo around Christmas? Well, we had a small change of plans :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/540d4ef1165dc4d461c14e6025b82797779215c0.png[/img]

Sadly, it turned out that there's much more work to be done than we've anticipated. Although we really want to give you a taste of "ClockVenture" we decided that an [b]additional month after Christmas[/b] is needed.

That's all for this announcement! See ya!

notes.title: 05.12.22 - Cooming soon! The demo of our game, "ClockVenture"!
notes.notes:
Hello, travelers!

Last time we talked about giving you a taste of our game. Now it's time for specifics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/e6e432dce0251e72917a6ecdd292e616ae0b087b.png[/img]

Game demo of "ClockVenture" will be released soon - we're aiming for the time [b]around Christmas[/b] (mark the date!)

With the release of the demo, we're going to launch a Discord server! You will be able to ask questions about the game, be up to date with the progress of our work, or just chat with us :]

Enough with the announcements! See you next time!

notes.title: 07.11.22 - What have we been up to?
notes.notes:
Hey hey!

Seeing how we haven't given any sign of life for the last year, allow us to quickly tell you where we stand with our project...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/04cf486a6ba0e8c9353ef67e821fb7203e40d721.png[/img]

That's right! [b]A new title![/b]

"ClockWork" evolved into "ClockVenture". Let's welcome it with thunderous ovations!


And now for something completely different:
[list]
[*] [b]Playable demo![/b] In a month, we are planning to show you our game in action.
[*] Following the release of a demo, we will want to take care of better communication. That means [b]Discord channel[/b]. You'll be able to join soon.
[*] As for the [b]release date[/b]... we'd prefer to wait with this one :]
[/list]

That's it for today! See you soon!
